content: Confirmed from official Python docs (asyncio-platform-support): since Python 3.8 ProactorEventLoop is the DEFAULT asyncio event loop on Windows, and it supports subprocesses; SelectorEventLoop on Windows supports sockets only - no pipes, no subprocess_exec/subprocess_shell (NotImplementedError). Uvicorn on Windows: default loop auto = uvloop if installed (uvloop is not Windows-compatible) else asyncio; in single-process mode it uses Proactor, but under --reload or --workers it forces SelectorEventLoop, which breaks asyncio subprocess creation. Consequence for a Windows FastAPI wrapper that spawns scripts: workers=1, reload=False, and treat asyncio.create_subprocess_exec as working only in the default single-process Proactor setup.
